overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures premium spray dried pineapple powder sourced from sun-ripened Indian pineapples. Utilizing rapid evaporation spray drying technology, we preserve the authentic tropical flavor, vibrant color, and natural fruit aroma. The resulting fine powder provides rapid dissolution and uniform texture across diverse industrial processing lines, ensuring seamless integration into varied commercial formulations.

As an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter, we maintain complete traceability across our six-step manufacturing process. Every batch is produced under strict physical and microbial quality inspections to ensure less than 5% moisture content. We support global distributors and food brands with flexible bulk supply, comprehensive export documentation, and custom packaging solutions.
highlights: Fine particle profile of 80 to 100 mesh for quick solubility
Low moisture content maintained below 5 percent
Extended shelf life of 18 to 24 months
Consistent free-flowing powder with authentic tropical flavor
Derived from fresh sun-ripened Indian pineapple juice
Even dispersion suitable for dry blends and liquid formulations
applications: Instant beverage blends and tropical smoothies
Bakery products, pastries, and bread mixes
Yogurts, ice creams, and dairy desserts
Dry sauce mixes and fruit glazes
Seasoning blends and savory snack coatings

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for spray dried pineapple powder?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 Kg, accommodating both pilot product development and full-scale commercial manufacturing runs.

faqs.q: What are the standard product specifications?
faqs.a: The powder features a mesh size of 80-100, moisture levels below 5%, and a shelf life of 18-24 months when stored in a cool, dry place.

faqs.q: What packaging options are available for bulk and retail buyers?
faqs.a: We provide bulk supply in 25 kg bags and HDPE containers, intermediate 5-10 kg bags, and customized private-label pouches or jars.

faqs.q: Can you provide product samples before placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, product samples are available upon request to assist with your formulation testing and quality evaluation.

faqs.q: Do you offer custom mesh sizes and private-label packaging?
faqs.a: Yes, we support OEM and private-label requirements, including tailored mesh sizes, specialized packaging formats, and custom labeling.

faqs.q: What regulatory and shipping support do you provide for exports?
faqs.a: As an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter, we handle comprehensive export documentation to ensure prompt and compliant customs clearance.
